newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Kredietbank unit to buy French Transbourse.
newsitem.headline: Kredietbank unit to buy French Transbourse.

text.p: Brokerage KB-Securities, a unit of Belgium's Kredietbank, said on Monday it would take over French stock-broking firm Transbourse, subject to the approval of regulatory authorities.

It said Transbourse's existing shareholders -- Banque Gestion Privee, BRED Banque Populaire and VP-Bourse -- would sell their respective 50.3 percent, 39.7 percent and 10 percent stakes in Transbourse to KB-Securities.
Financial details were not immediately available.
Transbourse, which specialises in trading for third parties, had 1.1 percent of Paris bourse traded volume in 1996.
